label: signed a2-vs-a1 choice code: policy plus last/current action, low after no reward at D1
explanation: The candidate value of unit 5 is a signed choice code: high when the agent favours or just made a2, low for a1. It follows the model policy (tanh of the a1-a2 logit, negative weight, weaker at D1), plus the previous choice (a2 +, a1 -) and at D2 the choice just made. At D1 it drops further after an unrewarded trial. No future variables are used (action at D2 is already observed). Without the model policy term, observed cues alone (previous action, action two trials back, D2 action, D1 reward) give dev R^2 about 0.68.
final_label: signed a2-vs-a1 choice code: policy plus last/current action, low after no reward at D1
